note: Ownership (string deep copy) via 0x33: Duplicate of a 0x16 deep-copies (opcodes.md conventions). 0xb0 makes string 1; Pull 1 pushes a copy, string 2. 0x52 returns string 2 and disposes string 1; the host disposes the result after R. allocs s 2, live s 0.
